current_observations.trace: Native startup loads the configuration through TacticalAudioConfig::load and parse; wasm_run and wasm_boot also call parse, and run inserts the admitted result as a resource. parse first derives Deserialize and then invokes validate. Finite unit-range volumes, positive finite pitch factors and radius, ordered positive randomization endpoints, and the selected wind/rain thresholds are checked on this route. The structs retain raw f32/u16 fields, with crate-visible fields and a separately derived Deserialize implementation. A crate-wide source-name search found no alternate production constructor besides these startup paths; it does not prove that a future/direct deserializer or indirect mutation cannot bypass parse.
current_observations.qualification: Do not characterize the ordinary startup path as unvalidated or infer a current bypass from type visibility. Source search and unchanged source hashes are bounded, not all-producer proof.

current_observations.trace: Contact presentation events are emitted from observed skeleton contact sequences. The movement consumer can call play_rustle for grass/reeds or nearby understory; it reads the base speed and pitch range as f32. Equal endpoints approximately 1e-30 and a base approximately 1e-30 satisfy the individual finite-positive predicates; their f32 product is below the smallest positive f32 subnormal and rounds to zero. Conversely approximately 1e30 multiplied by approximately 1e30 exceeds finite f32. PlaybackSpeed::new and Mul merely retain/multiply f32; the wasm backend passes the result to window.sfxPlay. These are conditional arithmetic/source counterexamples to the same historical first contract, not executed YAML, audio or gameplay witnesses.
current_observations.qualification: An input must produce those finite values and reach the relevant contact/rustle path. The repository-shipped tuning is ordinary, and no failure is asserted for it. Individual input acceptance does not prove full YAML tokenization or every intermediate feature.

current_observations.trace: For an audible initialized mixer and loaded sound, sfxPlay queues the speed; the worklet stores it in voiceSpeed and begins at position zero. For a sound with positive sample length, zero speed keeps position at zero and never satisfies position >= length, so the voice is not released by that completion condition. freeVoice may later replace it when capacity is needed. This follows from source control flow under the stated inputs and is not a measured audio, resource-growth or gameplay incident.
current_observations.qualification: An unavailable sound, suspended context, exhausted per-frame starts, zero-length decoded buffer, finite voice pool replacement, or unobserved source path changes the result. Do not equate one held slot with unbounded growth or claim the audible samples.

current_observations.trace: Combat impacts interpolate their own individually validated positive pitch endpoints and call PlaybackSpeed::new directly; that is a distinct path and does not multiply the separate rustle base factor. Wind and rain compute gains from validated config and scene weather, then pass LinearVolume to the backend; rain retains a layer array of LinearVolume, whose new constructor itself checks no invariant. Movement volume and range values pass through private helpers before the final StereoGain and PlaybackSpeed wrappers. Positive finite bush radius is squared at the native proximity arithmetic kernel.
current_observations.qualification: These observations do not establish a second invalid combat result, an incorrect rain gain, or a necessary global tuning cap. Preserve zero volume and existing arithmetic/determinism; independently trace all producers, field consumers and possible numerical extremes before closure.
